question: List the names and emails of all customers from Austin.
gold_sql: SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE city = 'Austin';

question: How many products are in the Electronics category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics';

question: What is the total quantity ordered for each product?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name;

question: List all orders that are still pending, most recent first.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY order_date DESC;

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

question: What is the average unit price of products in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category;

question: Find the top 5 customers by number of orders placed.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List order items along with the product name and category for order 1.
gold_sql: SELECT oi.order_item_id, p.name, p.category, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 1;
